textEn: Welcome. You've come a long way through the lanes.

textKo: 한잔 사 주시겠나? 우리 아이들도 손님을 기다리고 있어.
textEn: Buy a round? Our attendants are waiting for a guest.
Understood. The board and jobs are always here.
Hi. Shall we take tonight slow?

textKo: 고마워요. 이 한잔으로 잠시 별을 잊게 해드릴게요.
textEn: Thank you. This drink will help you forget the stars for a bit.

textKo: 항로 이야기는 나중에… 지금은 음악만 들어요.
textEn: Lane stories later — for now just the music.

textKo: 사실 저는 오케스트라 연습실 출신이에요. 여기가 더 따뜻하더라고요.
textEn: I used to train in an orchestra room. This place feels warmer.
Come — just one beat with me.
Rest under the phosphor glow.

textKo: 잔이 따뜻해질 때까지 말없이 있어도 돼요.
textEn: You can stay quiet until the glass warms.
Leave the noise outside.
A quiet night is the dearest service.
Matching breath is already a dance.
I saved you a seat.
Sip slow. Jazz never hurries.

textKo: 손님 함선… 엔진음이 조금 피곤해 보였어요.
textEn: Your ship's engines sounded a little tired.

textKo: 이 바은 늦은 밤에 더 솔직해져요.
textEn: This bar grows honest after midnight.
One swing phrase — start with the shoulders.
Want a verse of starlight song?
Thanks. Songs taste better with a drink.
The nebula outside looks closer tonight.

textKo: 항로마다 다른 별이 있어요. 손님 별은 어떤 색인가요?
textEn: Every lane has a different star. What color is yours?

textKo: 손을 조금 올려 봐요. 별이 따라올 거예요.
textEn: Lift your hand a little. The stars will follow.
Just follow one step.
One drink and the rhythm wakes up.
Trust only your toes.

textKo: 무도회는 전쟁보다 정직해요. 박자가 거짓말하지 않거든요.
textEn: A ballroom is more honest than war. The beat never lies.
Come — one turn!
Quiet stories today — no rumors.
I can hear you even under the glass.
Some lanes are not on the map.
Secrets cool faster than drinks. Only now.
Closer… just one beat.
We start with one clap.
The spark caught. This drink!
Cheer loud. Part short.
Even in ashes a toast remains.
Clap! Then one step.

textKo: 제 화음에 맞춰 숨을 내쉬어 봐요.
textEn: Exhale with my harmony.
When the glass rings the song begins.
An echo means you are not alone.

textKo: 같은 곡도 듣는 사람에 따라 달라요.
textEn: The same song changes with the listener.
Shall we leave a little aftertone?

textKo: 또 들러 주세요. 잔이 식기 전에.
textEn: Come again before the glass goes cold.
